Her name. From memory:
SPRINKLEPOP
I need twenty balloons! {.}For / a party I haven't been / invited to yet.
column2: ¡Necesito veinte globos! {.}Para una fiesta a la que aún // no me han invitado.

column1: YET. {!}Twisty gives them out / if you pop the bad ones.
column2: AÚN. {!}Twisty los da si / revientas los malos.

column1: Win her twenty balloons?
Party time!
Later.
Pop the grey ones, keep the / pink ones. {.}Twenty pink and / they're yours!
column2: Revienta los grises, guarda / los rosas. {.}¡Veinte rosas / y son tuyos!

column1: Twenty! {.}Plus a bonus. I / made one of YOU.
column2: ¡Veinte! {.}Y un extra. Hice / uno de TI.

column1: (The balloon-you has the / wrong number of ears.)
column2: (El globo-tú tiene el número / equivocado de orejas.)

column1: It's an interpretation.
You popped a pink one. {..}It's / fine. They're only feelings. / Have another go.
column2: Reventaste uno rosa. {..}No pasa nada. Solo son sentimientos. Inténtalo otra // vez.

column1: TWENTY! {!}Now I'm ready for / whoever invites me.
column2: ¡VEINTE! {!}Ya estoy lista para / quien me invite.

column1: Ah-{.}CHOO!
Ah-{..}choo.
(Purple glitter.)
Doctors say it's fine!
(Behind her, twenty balloons / turn on their strings to / face the Wall.)
column2: (Tras ella, veinte globos / giran en sus cuerdas / hacia el Muro.)

column1: (She doesn't notice.)
(A queue outside Cloud Nine / Vapor. Sprinklepop is first. / She's brought a balloon.)
column2: (Una cola afuera de Cloud Nine Vapor. Sprinklepop es la // primera. Trajo un globo.)

column1: Sprinklepop's soul wandered / off. {..}With its map upside / down.
column2: El alma de Sprinklepop se / fue de paseo. {..}Con el mapa / al revés.

column1: Souls go exactly as far as / they're scared to. {.}Follow / the glitter.
column2: Las almas llegan justo hasta / donde les da miedo. {.}Sigue / la brillantina.

column1: Follow the trail?
On it.
Not now.
(Purple glitter, in a line. / It starts at her lollipop / stand.)
column2: (Brillantina morada, en fila. Empieza en su puesto de // paletas.)

column1: (A tiny see-through balloon / is tied to the stand. {.}It / bobs.)
column2: (Un globito transparente está atado al puesto. {.}Se // mece.)

column1: (Somebody saw 'a bouncy / see-through bunny reading a / map wrong'. Heading west.)
column2: (Alguien vio 'un conejito saltarín transparente leyendo // mal un mapa'. Rumbo al oeste.)

column1: (At the Fun Fair: a / see-through cake. Seven / see-through candles.)
column2: (En el Fun Fair: un pastel / transparente. Siete velas / transparentes.)

column1: {d}She ordered that.
(The trail goes on toward / the pond.)
(Little balloons on the / water. The glitter turns / east. Toward the Wall.)
column2: (Globitos sobre el agua. La / brillantina gira al este. / Hacia el Muro.)

column1: (The polaroid: the soul at / the Wall, waving. {.}Its map is / the right way up.)
column2: (La polaroid: el alma en el / Muro, saludando. {.}Su mapa / está al derecho.)

column1: (It looks at Hillvile. It / looks at Hellvile.)
(It chooses Hellvile.)
(The pet sniffs the crack. / 'beep.' {..}It went through.)
She went toward the party she / wasn't invited to.
column2: Fue hacia la fiesta a la que / no la invitaron.

column1: {..}That's not lost. That's / brave.
column2: {..}Eso no es estar perdida. / Es ser valiente.

column1: (Just the Wall. {.}The soul / bounced off to the side. / Try again.)
column2: (Solo el Muro. {.}El alma / rebotó hacia un lado. / Inténtalo otra vez.)

column1: (Somewhere in Hellvile, a / man with a cough names a / little ghost 'Sprinkles'.)
column2: (En algún lugar de Hellvile, un hombre con tos llama 'Sprinkles' a un // fantasmita.)

column1: I cough out little ghosts. {.}I / name them.
One's bigger. Pink. Throws / parties. {..}I call her / Sprinkles. She's mine.
column2: Uno es más grande. Rosa. Hace fiestas. {..}La llamo // Sprinkles. Es mía.

column1: Meet the ghosts?
Introduce me.
(A small ghost bows.) {.}'Tuesday.'
(Another.) {.}'Wednesday.'
(Another.) {.}'Thursday.'
{d}(Another.) 'Also Thursday.'
I had a long week.
(Sprinkles sneezes glitter / on Sunday. {.}Catch every / sneeze in the jar!)
column2: (Sprinkles estornuda brillantina el domingo. {.}¡Atrapa // cada estornudo en el frasco!)

column1: (A jar full of sneezes. It / glows pink.)
column2: (Un frasco lleno de estornudos. / Brilla rosa.)

column1: (Sprinkles waves a map. / It's the right way up.)
column2: (Sprinkles agita un mapa. / Está al derecho.)

column1: Tell Wheezle, gently:
She's somebody's friend.
She's visiting.
She's a party guest.
...She's not mine.
{..}But she can visit?
Laughing was against the law / here. So I swallowed them.
column2: Reír estaba prohibido aquí. / Así que me las tragué.

column1: They came out as ghosts. {..}She / taught them to throw parties.
column2: Salieron como fantasmas. {..}Ella / les enseñó a hacer fiestas.

column1: (Little ghosts are having a / party in your Hell Pits / flat. You didn't throw it.)
column2: (Unos fantasmitas hacen una / fiesta en tu piso de Hell / Pits. Tú no la organizaste.)

column1: A soul going home is an / exorcism run backwards.
column2: Un alma que vuelve a casa es / un exorcismo al revés.

column1: I've never done one. {.}The / scroll says 'probably'.
column2: Nunca he hecho uno. {.}El / pergamino dice 'probablemente'.

column1: Bring the soul home?
Let's un-fail it.
Not yet.
(The soul is waiting at the / Wall gate. {.}It bounces.)
column2: (El alma espera en la puerta / del Muro. {.}Rebota.)

column1: (The soul bounces ahead. / Keep it in sight, or it / starts a party.)
column2: (El alma rebota adelante. / No la pierdas de vista o / empieza una fiesta.)

column1: Metronome in reverse. {.}The / bell will un-ring. {..}That / used to be scary.
column2: Metrónomo al revés. {.}La / campana se des-tocará. {..}Eso / antes daba miedo.

column1: (The stamp: EXORCISM / UNFAILED x1. A kazoo, played / backwards: 'wahhh wah wah.')
column2: (El sello: EXORCISMO DESHECHO x1. Un kazoo, tocado // al revés: 'wahhh wah wah.')

column1: (She wakes. Pink glitter.)
{..}What's my name again?
THAT'S IT! {!}You remembered!
Close! It's Sprinklepop. {.}I / forgive you. I was asleep.
I had the best dream. / Everyone was invited.
column2: Tuve el mejor sueño. / Todos estaban invitados.

column1: ...Was I?
{big}YES.{/}
(The whole clinic said it.)
The bell rang the right way. / {..}That's the wrong way. Again.
column2: La campana sonó al derecho. / {..}Ese es el lado equivocado. De nuevo.

column1: She bounced off to a party. / {.}Ask me again; she'll be back / at the gate.
column2: Rebotó hacia una fiesta. / {.}Pregúntame otra vez; volverá / a la puerta.

column1: (A heart balloon bobs past / your window. Someone under / it is bouncing.)
column2: (Un globo de corazón pasa flotando por tu ventana. Alguien // debajo viene rebotando.)
